properties.description: The bronze sink for the raw scan bytes. Same Binary type and same dt=/hour= partitioning as landing, so the copy is a straight passthrough and bronze remains partition-aligned with landing for replay. Keeping the partition path identical is what lets a failed hour be re-copied by re-running the pipeline with the same parameters — the target path is a pure function of (dt, hour), so a rerun overwrites rather than duplicates.
